title: How to split chores fairly as a family
description: A simple, fair way to split household chores across a family so the load doesn't quietly land on one person.
h1: How to split chores fairly as a family
directAnswer: Splitting chores fairly starts with picking one shared system everyone can see, not a private list living in one parent's head. Give each child an age-appropriate chore, post it somewhere the whole family checks every morning, and review the split together once a week so the load never quietly slides back onto a single person carrying it alone.
keyTakeaway: A visible system beats a fair-sounding rule nobody can see.

sections.heading: Start with one visible list
sections.html: Move the chore list out of your head and into a place the whole household actually looks at each day.

sections.heading: Match chores to age
sections.html: Younger children can handle small, concrete jobs; older kids can own a whole routine end to end.
